verdict.rationale: Scheduled scanning is a fair axis for a code-security platform, but the evidence shows no recurring schedule. The documentation covers scans triggered by events (push, pull requests, pre-commit) and running Semgrep as a job inside CI providers. Event triggers are one-off actions rather than a recurring schedule, and any scheduling done by the CI host belongs to the host platform, not Semgrep. Managed Scans is described only as bulk onboarding without CI changes, with no mention of scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
